title: Critical strip-crossing mass on the honeycomb lattice

abstractEnglish: At the critical weight of the regular honeycomb lattice, the total weight of self-avoiding paths crossing a strip of height N is comparable to N−1/4. The first horizontal-displacement moment of return paths is comparable to N3/4.
